root.label: Education Department FAFSA identity verification savings

events.label: Education Department FAFSA identity verification savings

slots.name: taxpayer savings
slots.sentence: In June, the Education Department also said it saved taxpayers nearly $200 million after requiring high-risk applicants to present government-issued identification when applying for federal student aid, Fox News Digital previously reported.

slots.name: verification rate
slots.sentence: The department took aim at weak fraud safeguards under former President Joe Biden, accusing his administration of requiring less than 1% of students to verify their identity following their FAFSA submission during the COVID-19 pandemic era.
